name: Alert (iOS)
summary: A small centered dialog that gives important information or asks for a decision. It interrupts, so keep it rare. Buttons sit side by side for two choices and stack vertically (vertical auto layout) for three or more.

anatomy.purpose: Short and specific. Sentence case, no period.
One or two lines of detail.
Two buttons side by side, or a stacked list (vertical auto layout) for three or more.
Semibold button that is the safest or most likely choice.
Red button for actions that delete or can not be undone.

whenToUse: Critical information or a choice that blocks the next step.
whenNotToUse: Routine messages: use a banner or inline message.
Long content or forms: use a sheet.

keyboard: VoiceOver reads the title and message, then the buttons.
Escape or the Cancel button dismisses it.
accessibility.focus: Focus moves to the alert and returns to the trigger when it closes.
notes: Button labels are verbs: Delete, Keep, Cancel. Never OK alone for a destructive choice.
Cancel is always offered for destructive actions.
